decision.rationale: TXN-007958 is a charge of 1679 EUR cents (16.79 EUR) on card CRD-000106. The charge was made at Bramble Streaming (MER-000053), a merchant that bills on a recurring basis, on 2026-09-16 and posted on 2026-09-17. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 43 days after posting. That is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The cardholder says they cancelled by phone but has nothing in writing. No documents are attached, so there is no merchant cancellation confirmation and no effective date to compare with the charge date. Under recurring-no-proof, the next step is to ask the merchant for its cancellation records and the subscription terms.

proposed_actions.note: Please send your cancellation records for this card's subscription, including any record of a phone cancellation request and when it took effect, and the subscription's cancellation terms that applied to the 16.79 EUR charge made on 2026-09-16.
